image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a transparent plastic audio cassette tape resting on a white surface. The cassette contains a pink paper label with handwritten text and visible internal spools with brown magnetic tape. The plastic casing shows molded details like screw holes and tape guides.

artifact_observations.location: Pink label on the cassette face
artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten text on the pink label is illegible and lacks coherent character structure, appearing as scribbled lines rather than distinct letters or numbers. This is a common AI artifact when rendering specific text.

The internal mechanical parts (spools/gears) appear slightly soft and lack the sharp, precise engineering edges typical of real injection-molded plastic parts. There is a slight 'melting' or smoothing effect on the fine details.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom right corner of the cassette casing
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight warping or inconsistency in the straightness of the plastic edge near the bottom right screw hole, though minor.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cassette and not a similar rectangular plastic object.
To analyze the illegible handwritten text on the pink label for coherence and artifact detection.
To verify the structural integrity of the transparent plastic shell and ensure no fusion errors between internal and external parts.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle texture anomalies in the plastic reflections.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of handwritten text on the label
Sharpness and geometric correctness of internal spool mechanisms
Transparency and refraction effects of the plastic casing
Structural integrity of molded details (screw holes, slots)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the pink label; AI often fails to render coherent handwriting, resulting in gibberish. Also, inspect the internal spools for realistic mechanical detail versus smoothed/melted plastic artifacts. Ensure the transparency of the casing interacts correctly with the internal components (no floating parts).
